about_the_game:
Introduction

In Tao Ancestor's Vanquisher you play as Xuan Che, the Eternal Dao Ancestor betrayed in his past life and reborn into the body of a despised "good-for-nothing" youth. Now the young master of the Profound Heaven Sect who cannot even gather spiritual energy, he endures public scorn and internal family strife. Faced with a disappointed fiancée, mocking peers, and hidden enemies from his past, will you live in obscurity or reclaim your power to settle old scores? In this tale of power, betrayal, and redemption, the epic secret of the "Heart-Devouring Curse" begins to unfold.

 

Features

Subverts Tropes: Reborn as a max-level expert. Focus on personal growth, relationships, and strategic plots over leveling up.

Complex Characters: Morally grey cast with deep motives, especially the nuanced antagonist Zi Xuan.

Full Chinese VO: High-quality voice acting enhances immersion.

Your Choices Matter: Decisions lead to vastly different endings.

Authentic Soundtrack: Traditional Chinese melodies and intense battle music.

Objectives

Primary Goal: Uncover the truth of your past betrayal, confront your clan's crisis and the demon invasion, and face the ultimate threat—the Heart-Devouring Demon Sovereign, a calamity born from your own actions.

Conceal Your Power: Master the balance between your "useless" facade and necessary displays of strength to avoid premature attention.

Clan Politics: Navigate schemes from envious siblings, discrimination from outer-clan disciples, and infiltration by external forces.

Complex Relationships: Manage nuanced ties with your fiancée, a loyal maidservant, and others; your choices will shape their destinies.

Test of Dao Heart: Face powerful enemies and moral crossroads. Your principles—whether you uphold righteousness or embrace ruthlessness—will determine your final ascension.

Character

Xuan Che — Play as the young master of Xuantian Sect, secretly reborn as a Grand Dao Ancestor. Though appearing powerless, he wields strength far beyond the Nascent Soul realm and commands the primal forces of heaven and earth. Uncover the truth of his rebirth and reshape the destiny of his sect.

Zixuan - Xuan Che's loyal maid. Once an ordinary mortal, she rapidly ascends to the power of the Nascent Soul realm. Initially kind and devoted, she grows arrogant and cold with her newfound strength, harboring deep contempt for her humble past.

Han Xuesheng — Xuan Che's fiancée. Values status and strength above all, her feelings toward him torn between lingering expectations and profound disappointment.

Mo Cangqiong — Senior disciple of the Xuantian Sect. An orphan who ultimately betrayed his clan, his treachery deepening the sect’s crisis.

Mysterious Figure: Xuan Sheng — Founder of the Xuantian Sect, who should have perished in a heavenly tribulation but survived through demonic energy. Now a shadowy puppeteer, he guides Zixuan to embrace both demonic power and heavenly trials.

  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 6500
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060或相同配置
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Configuration will be corrected again during release

short_description: A story-rich single-player AVG RPG. Features a 2-hour main storyline with multiple branching narratives, encompassing political intrigue, demon clan wars, and emotional entanglements. confront the apocalyptic crisis of the demon clan's resurgence.
